title: Towards combinatorial derivations of K-polynomials for determinantal varieties
summary: Let $\mathfrak{X}_k\subseteq{\sf Mat}_{m, n}$ denote the variety of $m\times n$ complex matrices with rank at most $k$. The power series and rational expressions for the Hilbert series of $\mathfrak{X}_k$ are known by geometric arguments, and equating these expressions yields a family of formulas generalizing the classical Cauchy and dual Cauchy identities. We pose the problem of giving a direct combinatorial proof of these formulas for $0 < k < \min\{m, n\}$.
